title: Expressing support for local law enforcement officers.
latestAction: Star Print ordered on the referred concurrent resolution.
summary: This concurrent resolution recognizes and appreciates local law enforcement officers, extends gratitude to local law enforcement officers and their families, honors local law enforcement officers who have fallen in the line of duty, and encourages continued collaboration between local law enforcement agencies and the communities they serve.
